title: Cluster Version Report
description: Raw output schema for EKS/Kubernetes version checks. Produced by querying cluster state and AWS supported versions.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the check was run.

current_version.description: Currently deployed Kubernetes version on the cluster.

latest_supported_version.description: Latest Kubernetes version supported by Amazon EKS.

end_of_support_date.description: Date when the current version reaches end of standard support, if known.

upgrade_path.description: Ordered list of version steps required to reach the latest supported version (EKS supports sequential minor version upgrades only).

release_notes_url.description: URL to the EKS release notes or Kubernetes changelog for the target version.
